method: Deterministic spaced samples from five provenance/tier strata, plus three flagged wording/theme checks; purposive, not a statistical error-rate estimate.

row.explanations: luna: Those who reject the signs and deny them are companions of the Fire, the contrary end to following guidance.

context.2:39: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ

2:39.assessment_reason: Its preceding ayah explicitly promises guidance to be followed. The contrary destination is relevant to the section’s last paragraph.

row.explanations: luna: The servant announces their parting and promises to explain what Moses could not patiently witness.

18:78.assessment_reason: The note summarises the teacher–Moses episode’s parting. It supplies no specific mechanism for this image; keep as context for the following-a-guide passage rather than an independently strong discovery.

row.explanations: luna: Those gathered on their faces toward Hell are the worst in position and furthest astray from the way (أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا).

context.25:33: وَلَا يَأْتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَحْسَنَ تَفْسِيرًا
context.25:34: ٱلَّذِينَ يُحْشَرُونَ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّۭ مَّكَانًۭا وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلًۭا

25:34.assessment_reason: Being gathered toward Hell while described as furthest astray from the way closely matches the section’s reversed guidance toward Hell.

row.explanations: luna: People are told to turn to their Lord and submit before punishment comes, a return to the way before the final destination.

row.explanations: luna: People do not will except as God wills, holding human choice and divine guidance together.

row.explanations: luna: People enter God's religion in crowds (يَدْخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا), a community gathering onto the way.

context.110:2: وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًۭا

110:2.assessment_reason: Entering religion in groups can meet the section’s community and habitual-course readings. The road imagery is interpretive and needs an explicit paragraph-level link.

row.explanations: terra: Exchanging faith for disbelief is explicitly called losing the even road, "ضَلَّ سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ".

row.explanations: terra: The best religion belongs to one who submits to God, does good, and follows the upright religion of Abraham.

row.explanations: terra: Those who bar from God's way and seek crookedness in it are named as deniers of the final arrival.

row.explanations: terra: The Book is "قَيِّمًۭا"—upright—so as to warn and give good news, carrying the q-w-m family into revelation itself.

row.explanations: terra: Iblīs swears by God's might that he will mislead them all.

row.explanations: terra: Moses is sent to Pharaoh with the invitation, "وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ".

context.79:18: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ

79:18.assessment_reason: Terra quotes the entire guidance clause of 79:19 under reference 79:18. 79:18 is the invitation to purification. The two-ayah passage is relevant, but the quotation’s source is wrong.

row.explanations: luna: God promises that when guidance (هُدًى) comes from Him, whoever follows it will have no fear or grief. | terra: When guidance comes from God, those who follow it have neither fear nor grief: the traveller's instruction is to follow.

row.explanations: luna: Iblis vows to sit in ambush on God's straight path (صِرَاطَكَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ), making the traveled route contested ground. | terra: Iblīs vows to sit in ambush on God's straight road, "صِرَٰطَكَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ".

context.7:16: قَالَ فَبِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأَقْعُدَنَّ لَهُمْ صِرَٰطَكَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ

row.explanations: luna: Jesus again joins worship of God (اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ) to the straight way (صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ). | terra: Jesus repeats that shared lordship and worship are the straight road.

row.explanations: luna: The Prophet is told to hold fast to what is revealed because he is on a straight path (صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ). | terra: The messenger is told to hold fast to revelation because he is upon a straight road.

row.explanations: luna: God finds the Prophet ضَالًّا and guides him (فَهَدَىٰ); this can mean one who had not found the way, as well as one astray. | terra: "وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّۭا فَهَدَىٰ" holds lostness and being led together in the compact reversal that closes Fātiḥah.
